frequency.stageImpact: Monthly PoR is acceptable as a transitional baseline, but insufficient for Stage 2 without daily root/commitment anchoring, event-triggered updates, or stronger cadence.
frequency.notes: Binance publishes recurring monthly PoR snapshots. This report does not establish event-triggered publication rules or official daily canonical anchoring.

summary.headline: Binance provides public reserve summary and wallet_address_list artifacts for PR01JUN26, and ardmere can reproduce several reserve-side checks, but Stage 1 is blocked by missing wallet_ownership_proof, opaque trusted setup evidence, and unavailable public global proof/vk artifacts.
summary.rationale: The available artifacts support Gen 2 / E2 classification and Stage 0 PoR disclosure. Internal consistency and solvency-claim checks pass, and reserve-side on-chain checks provide partial coverage with several WARN/FAIL/UNVERIFIABLE findings. However, users still need to trust Binance for wallet control, trusted setup honesty, and public availability of the full global proof stack.
summary.scope: Binance PR01JUN26 / period 43. Wallet ZIP date is 2026-06-01, while the BAPI snapshot payload records snapshotTime as 2026-01-06T00:00:00Z; this mismatch is treated as a scope caveat.
limitations: Assessment uses locally archived ardmere artifacts under artifacts/binance/PR01JUN26-20260601-period43.
Verification bundle v2 is used for verifier summary.
Several on-chain checks are affected by RPC/archive availability, block-height boundary differences, and chain-specific accounting semantics.
No public wallet_ownership_proof, trusted setup transcript, public global proof.csv/vk bundle, or third-party attestation artifact was available to this pipeline.

stageBlockedReasons.reason: Binance publishes a wallet_address_list, but no public batch-verifiable wallet_ownership_proof was available.
No public trusted setup transcript or transparent setup evidence was available for the zk proof system.
The public pipeline did not have access to global proof.csv and verifying keys; global-zk-proof is UNVERIFIABLE.

riskFlags.message: wallet_ownership_proof is missing, so users must trust that Binance controls the listed wallet_address_list addresses.
Trusted setup transcript is not publicly verifiable, so users must trust setup honesty.

evidence.value: No public MPC transcript or transparent setup evidence was included in the archived artifacts.

riskFlags.message: global-zk-proof, address-ownership, third-party-attestation, and cross-chain-wrapped verifiers are UNVERIFIABLE for this snapshot.
A third-party ardmere anchor exists for the archived bundle, but this does not replace an official exchange-controlled canonical Stage 2 anchor.
The public pipeline cannot confirm that proof constraints fully cover Binance's actual business risks, including lending, margin, collateral haircuts, and negative balance constraints.

evidence.value: No public proof constraints package was available to ardmere for this snapshot.

missing.reason: No public wallet ownership signature/proof bundle is available.
No public MPC transcript or transparent setup evidence is available.
Global proof.csv / verifying key is not publicly distributed to this pipeline.
No machine-readable independent third-party attestation artifact is available.

verifierResults.reason: HotCold+Deposit aggregated for BAPI reconciliation; 66 PASS findings.
Reserve-side HotCold checks include 1 FAIL, 4 WARN, 155 UNVERIFIABLE, and 1 PASS findings in v2 bundle.
Token checks include 4 FAIL, 202 WARN, 38 UNVERIFIABLE, and 1 PASS findings in v2 bundle.
Ledger checks include 9 FAIL, 151 WARN, 68 UNVERIFIABLE, and 1 PASS findings in v2 bundle.
Value-weighted deposit sample has 300 WARN findings and more than 25% sampled rows failed RPC.
BTC block time anchor verifier not implemented.
No public download channel for wallet ownership signatures / proofs.
Global proof.csv / verifying key not publicly distributed.
No public third-party attestation report available.
Wrapped token reconciliation rules not finalized.

recommendations.text: Publish batch-verifiable wallet_ownership_proof for the PR01JUN26 wallet_address_list.
Publish trusted setup transcript / MPC ceremony, or migrate to a transparent setup proof system.
Publish global proof.csv, verifying keys, vk/config, and proof schema without login or manual request.
Add official canonical anchoring for proof/root/vk commitments and historical artifacts.
